theorems.name: Submission.mean_curvature_eq_normalPart_gram_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (y : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (S : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), Function.Injective A → tangentSpace M y = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → (∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M y (A a) (A b) = normalPart M y (S a b)) → meanCurvature M y = normalPart M y (∑ k : Fin n, ∑ l : Fin n, inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) (EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))) • S (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
